name: Nether Spirit converts Spirit into spell critical strike rating (#1602)
contract: Nether Spirit 300477 continuously converts 19% of Spirit into spell critical strike rating (CR_CRIT_SPELL, rating index 10), via the native SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT handler (HandleModRatingFromStat) rather than a hard-coded amount.
